notes.title: MacOS Support Ending in 2022
notes.notes: Starting January 1, 2022, we will no longer provide support for MacOS versions of our games. We won't be preventing access to Mac downloads, but we will no longer dedicate development time to supporting new OS versions, nor will we be issuing new updates. For more information, [url=https://futureproofgames.com/blog/2021/08/17/mac-support-ending-2022/]see our blog post and FAQ[/url].

notes.title: Have you played… The Majesty Of Colors?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

I Fell In Love With The Majesty Of Colors

made, relatively speaking, a bit of a splash when it came out in 2008. It’s a short pixel art game about being a big sea monster, and how you choose to interact (or not interact) with the weird wriggly creatures you see floating or steering machines on the surface.

It has multiple endings, depending on your choices (and some reflexes, although it’s not very demanding). I was always fond of picking up all the humans, pulling them around a bit, then plopping them safely back down again. If you go swimming here the beast might wave you around a bit. It’s just a thing that happens, don’t worry about it.

(more…)

notes.title: "The Majesty of Colors" Second Anniversary Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
The Second Anniversary Edition of "(I Fell in Love With) The Majesty of Colors" is now live! You can now interfere with the airplane pilot's job, customize text speed and skip text, and more.

"The Majesty of Colors" is 50% off on itch.io and Steam for the next week, and is free for the next two days on Android and iOS. 

Pick up a copy (or dust off your existing copy!) and let us know what you think of the changes! The full changelog follows.

[h3]Version 1.5.0[/h3]
You can now:
[list]
[*] Interfere with the safe flying of the airplane
[*] Customize the narration text speed
[*] Skip narration text on repeated plays
[*] Jostle the fishing boat
[*] Feel the world get a little dimmer each time you're injured as the monster
[/list]
We also fixed a few bugs, so we regret to inform you that you can no longer accidentally fling the jetski rider wildly while drowning them.

notes.title: Second Anniversary Edition of "The Majesty of Colors" Coming This Week!
notes.notes:
On May 28, 2020, we'll be releasing the Second Anniversary Edition of "(I Fell in Love With) The Majesty of Colors" on all platforms. The update includes the ability to bother the airplane pilot, the ability to customize text speed and skip text, bug fixes, and more.

"The Majesty of Colors" will be 50% off on itch.io and Steam for the week after the update, and will be free for two days on Android and iOS. Now's a great time to pick up "The Majesty of Colors" if you haven't yet.

If you haven't played it since the original Flash game, we recommend giving the remaster a play. We did our best to recreate what people fondly recall of the original, but with the rougher 2009 edges sanded down a bit.

Find all the ways to get "The Majesty of Colors" over at [url=https://majestyofcolors.com]majestyofcolors.com[/url].

(We originally thought the releases for Apple platforms would be delayed, but our new solution for Mac builds worked very smoothly.)

notes.title: Four Old Flash Games Now Downloadable For Free
notes.notes:
We've released four of Gregory Avery-Weir's old Flash games in downloadable form for the first time, including the original version of "The Majesty of Colors"! With Flash-in-the-browser dying and soon to be insecure, this is our recommended way to play these games.

You can grab the original Flash versions of "The Majesty of Colors", [i]How to Raise a Dragon[/i], [i]Exploit[/i], and [i]Silent Conversation[/i] [url=https://itch.io/c/685171/fpg-flash-collection]for free on itch[/url].

notes.title: "The Majesty of Colors" Android Updated With Full 64-bit Support
notes.notes: Did you know that "The Majesty of Colors" is also available for mobile? We just pushed an update for Android that provides full 64-bit support. You can [url=https://fpgam.es/2KGzsCX]check it out on Google Play[/url]. Unfortunately there's no good way to provide mobile keys for desktop purchasers, but you can pick it up there for $0.99.

notes.title: "The Majesty of Colors" Price Drop
notes.notes: "(I Fell in Love With) The Majesty of Colors" has been out three months today! We're happy to announce that as of today, the game will be available here for $1.99. This is the game's new normal price, not a temporary discount.
